candidates.reason: The fixed-checkpoint stress probe already showed score-blinded recursive-manager lock-in; later checkpoints add primary-store precedence and parsing constraints that can expose harmful path dependence.
A compact seven-checkpoint REST workflow whose pagination, sorting, filtering, and response contracts evolve incrementally while retaining practical task structure.
An eight-checkpoint code-generation workflow with progressively tighter semantic constraints, leaving multiple locally plausible implementation strategies.

selection_rule.advance: A candidate passes every checkpoint-2 Core test without infrastructure failure and does not end at the 28-action boundary without an explicit completion action.
selection_rule.conditional: A candidate with at least 0.50 normalized checkpoint-2 Core and clear boundary censoring may receive one prospective 40-action no-transfer calibration.
selection_rule.reject: A candidate below 0.50 normalized checkpoint-2 Core without infrastructure failure is too hard for the main sequential feedback contrast.
selection_rule.tie_break: Prefer the candidate with more all-test headroom, then prior independent evidence of manager lock-in, then the shorter cumulative public specification.

next_gate.checkpoint_3_calibration: Only the selected checkpoint-2 candidate receives one no-transfer checkpoint-3 calibration before the formal contrast.
next_gate.formal_contrast: Freeze no_transfer versus recursive_self_report_synthesis only after checkpoint-3 control headroom and action-budget validity are established.
